text:
The F&O market you trade today isn't the one you traded two years ago.

Changes since late 2024 have reshaped strategy design:
• Fewer weekly expiries: one weekly benchmark contract per exchange
• Larger contract sizes
• Changes to upfront premium collection and expiry-day margins
• Ongoing SEBI review of expiry-day dynamics and position limits

What this means for algo and F&O traders:
→ Expiry-day strategies built for the old calendar need a full rethink.
→ Capital needed per lot has gone up, so sizing and margin planning matter more.
→ Liquidity is concentrated in fewer contracts, which changes slippage assumptions.
→ Backtests that span the regime change can mislead you.

The traders who adapt quickly treat every rule change as a research project, not a complaint.
